title: Aureline M5 claim-block gate
description: Canonical per-domain claim-block gate minted by the retirement-tombstone and claim-block-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks a retired object from being offered as an active choice, so a retired line or stable-facing surface can never be newly selected, provisioned, or enabled. Records the claim-block scope a blocker sits in — a new-install selection (the object must not appear selectable in a new-install picker), a new-tenant / new-workspace provisioning flow (the object must not be provisioned for a new tenant), or an active-enablement toggle (the object must not be actively enabled or re-enabled) — and binds the affected retired-object reference, the affected readiness-check reference, the object-versus-successor reference, and the active block reason so install / update, marketplace, help / About, and CLI / headless surfaces read the retired-state truth directly rather than re-deriving it by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a retired object's claim-blocking state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
